explication: This repository is a collection of services, jobs, models, and shared frameworks for X recommendations. The principal workflow is constructing a For You feed: Home Mixer coordinates candidate retrieval, ranking, and filtering before serving a timeline; the README also documents Recommended Notifications. Shared data and model services support those surfaces. The source excerpts show parts of query transformation, feature hydration, similarity retrieval, and visibility evaluation; many service-to-service connections below are documented by the README rather than inspected source.
